data.narrative:
CX2 Industries, a Series A–stage Defense & Security company founded by Nathan Mintz and Porter Smith, has raised $46M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a universe of 10 comparable companies: 2 public peers (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private companies including Stark Defence, Castelion, Singularity, NODA AI, and Anduril Industries.

Two valuation methods were applied. Stage-progression modeling, using total raised ($46M) as a proxy and applying a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A advancement, implies a $92M valuation. Peer-median analysis across 4 same-sector, same-stage comparables yields $700M. The peer set spans $125M (NODA AI) to $4.0B (Stark Defence), indicating wide dispersion within the Defense & Security frontier-tech segment.

Triangulation across these two methods produces a valuation range with a low of $78M, median of $396M, and high of $805M. The wide spread—spanning more than one order of magnitude—reflects material uncertainty in the peer set composition and stage-progression assumptions. The median estimate of $396M serves as a focal point, though materiality attaches to the underlying assumption that CX2's risk profile and market position align with the sector median rather than occupying the tail of the distribution represented by Stark Defence or the lower bound by NODA AI.
